description: Create a new Google Docs document with the given title and optional initial plain-text content. Returns its id. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Create a brand-new Google Docs document with a given title, optionally seeding it with plain-text content inserted at the very start of the body. Returns the created document's id, which is then the 'id' argument for docs_get, docs_batch_update, and docs_export. Fails gsuite.not_connected if no account is linked.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with the new document id.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the document was created and give its id for follow-up edits or export.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Create a new Google Docs document.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing title. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: supply a title. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account.
